Privacy

Data controller: see our legal notice (in Spanish).

What data we process

If you write to us, we use your email address and message only to reply. We don't sell or share your data.

Advertising

This site shows Google AdSense ads. Google and its partners may use cookies to show ads based on your visits, provided you accept them in the consent notice. You can manage this in Google's ad settings.

Fonts

Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, so your browser connects to Google's servers.

Your rights

You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by writing to us, and complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).
